Hi. Me again :)

So I haven't received my Bitfortun BS2 yet. Nor have I received any freight
notifications in relation to it. Has the warehouse actually sent it? Can
you look into this please and provide an ETA?

Additionally, there is nothing to cap····video for the failing   Nexus
S1. It just blows its fuse when I plug it in. Originally I considered the
problem may be related to the power supply so I purchased another power
supply and the outcome was the same. I am happy to assist in
troubleshooting the problem, by taking photo's/videos of a non functional
unit won't produce any insight into what's going on. Note: I have been
replacing the fuse each time it blows with a 15amp fuse, the same amperage
as the original fuse supplied with the unit.

Handed to the team · Hardware fault beyond troubleshooting, RMA decision needs a person

Hi Laurie,

I checked your BS-2 on order Shop····, and no, it hasn't shipped. There's no tracking on it. On September 16 we wrote that your unit had left the manufacturer and that tracking would follow within a day. It never arrived, and two months on that isn't good enough. I don't have a date I can trust, so I've asked a colleague to get a straight answer from the manufacturer on where your unit actually is. They'll come back to you with that and a real ETA.

On the Nexus S1, thank you. You're right that a video wouldn't tell us anything. A fuse that blows as soon as the unit is plugged in, even with a second power supply and the correct 15A fuse, points to a fault inside the S1. Your report of loose contacts on the 240V side of the first supply fits with that. Please stop replacing the fuse and leave the unit unplugged, so nothing else gets damaged. I've sent everything you described to our technical team so they can review the unit for a return. If you can, please send a clear photo of the S1's serial number label and one of the loose contacts on the original power supply. Those will help them decide.

If you'd like to talk it through sooner, JD from our technical team is on our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf. Post in the server and mention @nullhashrate. Either way, you'll hear back from us in this thread on both orders.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
